Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget.

Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

We’re looking for a hybrid designer and Webflow developer to help bring a new brand to life across our website. This role is for someone who can both design page experiences and build them in Webflow—owning work end to end rather than handing it off.

You’ll partner closely with our creative director, existing Webflow developer, content team, and PM to move the rebrand forward quickly. Design and implementation will happen in parallel rather than as separate, sequential phases.

We’re also looking for someone who works in an AI-native way —using AI, LLMs, coding assistants, agents, and workflow automation to accelerate design, page creation, development, content operations, and QA while maintaining a high bar for quality and brand consistency.

What you'll do Design Design high-fidelity, on-brand page layouts, components, and templates that bring our new brand direction to the web Extend a small set of bespoke “hero” pages designed by our brand agency into a consistent, scalable system across the broader site Design a range of marketing pages, from interactive and motion-rich experiences to simpler, templatized pages Contribute to a reusable component and module library so design decisions propagate consistently across pages Apply strong visual, responsive, accessible, and conversion-focused design principles Build Build and launch net-new pages, templates, components, and modules in Webflow Create scalable Webflow systems using reusable components, variables, CMS collections, and responsive patterns Translate Figma designs—your own and others’—into clean, high-fidelity Webflow builds Implement interactions, animations, and custom HTML, CSS, or JavaScript when needed Reskin and migrate existing pages while ensuring they remain easy for nontechnical partners to maintain Use AI and automation Use AI and coding assistants to accelerate design exploration, content structuring, page creation, component development, custom code, and debugging Build or configure AI agents and workflow automations for CMS preparation, content transformation, metadata generation, page auditing, link validation, and QA Identify repetitive processes that can become reliable, reusable AI-assisted workflows while critically reviewing output for accuracy, accessibility, originality, and brand quality Ship & collaborate devices, browsers, and responsive breakpoints Ensure strong performance, accessibility, SEO fundamentals, analytics readiness, redirects, and launch quality Document key components, CMS structures, custom code, automations, and publishing workflows What we're looking for Strong design and Webflow development capabilities in one skill set, with a portfolio showing excellent visual and brand design alongside shipped, high-quality Webflow builds Speed—the ability to move quickly and ship high-quality work in a fast-moving environment with shifting inputs, priorities, and timelines A strong eye for systems, with experience creating scalable page templates, reusable components, module libraries, and CMS structures (e.g. shared templates with swappable color sets and content modules) Strong understanding of HTML and CSS, comfort using JavaScript or custom code when needed, and the ability to implement high-fidelity builds from Figma Strong hands-on experience with Webflow CMS, responsive behavior, reusable components, variables, and Webflow Interactions (IX2), including motion and interactive page elements Demonstrated professional experience using AI and LLM tools, including building or configuring AI agents and workflow automations for design, development, content, or QA workflows Strong attention to detail across responsive behavior, accessibility, QA, performance, SEO fundamentals, and design consistency Proactive and solutions-oriented, with the ability to communicate clearly, maintain momentum, and design and ship in parallel Nice to have Experience with GSAP, APIs, webhooks, or custom integrations Experience with analytics, experimentation, or conversion optimization Experience with major rebrands, content migrations, localization, or multi-product websites Contract details Hours: Full time, 40 hours a week Duration: 3 month, with strong likelihood of extension or conversion with positive performance Life at Flex We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company.

Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture.

Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace. Company Description
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences.

We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service.

We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood.

NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.
Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.
Job Description
NBCUniversal’s Intellectual Property Analytics, Operations, and Technology (IPAOT) team supports NBCUniversal’s content globally. The team builds applications to support our internal legal intellectual property partners as well as platform operations on YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook.

The applications help monitor NBCUniversal titles across search engines, data sharing networks, and various content deliver pipelines. The data is collected by the team and analyzed internally to support business-decision driving initiatives at the company.

The IPAOT team at NBCUniversal is looking for a self-motivated, highly organized, proactive, and passionate problem solver who will assist with the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of content and rights management systems, as well as content delivery systems and pipelines.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who can comfortably execute full-stack development. You will collaborate with other Software Engineers and Operations Analysts. This is a fast-paced role that interfaces with the entire department and many other internal business units and stakeholders at NBCUniversal.

Assist with software development using Python to design and build available, scalable, and secure back-end web services and APIs for a variety of legal and intellectual property stakeholders, including software for platforms such as YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook
Assist in the management and troubleshooting of production systems and refactoring of existing applications to improve business processes
Implement systems designs and software design patterns to write maintainable, testable, and robust software and services
Integrate with third-party APIs, including designing, implementing, and troubleshooting API connections to ensure seamless interoperability between systems
Manage and troubleshoot distributed systems and services in a production environment

3+ years of professional software development experience with Python and JavaScript (ReactJs)
3+ years of experience using SQL and RDBMS, preferably MariaDB or MySQL
Experience with RHEL-based Linux Distributions (Oracle Enterprise Linux or CentOS)
Comfort with git and related processes such as git flow, forking / branching strategies, and pull requests / code reviews
Experience developing, using, and understanding APIs
Professional experience in Object Oriented Development
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with attention to detail

Unit testing and mocking frameworks
CI/CD with build tools such as Jenkins/GoCD/GitHub Actions
Experience with networking and distributed systems
Familiarity with NOSQL database (Cassandra)
Understanding and using Message Queueing Systems (Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ)
Fully Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.
This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the  Benefits page  of the Careers website.

We are accepting applications for this position on an ongoing basis.

About Qompyl Qompyl is redefining trading by focusing on a hands-on, visual, and gamified strategy builder that empowers traders to create and refine their strategies with ease. Our core service is a mobile-first platform , emphasizing simplicity, accessibility, and real-time interaction.

We are building an interactive fintech product where performance, clean UX, and seamless integration between front-end and back-end systems are critical. Role Overview We are seeking a Full-Stack Developer with a strong front-end orientation , particularly in React Native , to help build and scale Qompyl ’s mobile-first trading platform.

While this is a full-stack role, the primary focus will be on mobile front-end development , user experience, and real-time data interaction. The ideal candidate is comfortable contributing to back-end systems (Python/FastAPI) but thrives in building intuitive, high-performance mobile interfaces.

This role is ideal for a front-end-leaning full-stack developer who enjoys building mobile experiences and can confidently collaborate on back-end systems. Key Responsibilities Front-End (Primary Focus) Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native . Ensure high performance, responsiveness, and smooth UX across iOS and Android.

Integrate RESTful APIs and WebSocket services for real-time financial data updates. Implement state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, Context API, etc.). Build reusable UI components and contribute to scalable front-end architecture. Optimize rendering of live market data and strategy simulations.

Back-End (Secondary Contribution) Contribute to back-end systems using Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and PostgreSQL . Support API design and integration between front-end and back-end services. Collaborate on performance optimization for real-time data handling. Participate in system architecture discussions.

General Responsibilities Maintain clean code standards and version control using Git/GitHub. Collaborate in sprint planning and delivery using Azure DevOps. Contribute to architectural decisions for scalability and maintainability. Foster strong communication and a collaborative team culture.

Requirements Strong experience with React Native in production environments . Solid experience in JavaScript/TypeScript . Experience integrating REST APIs and real-time WebSocket services. Experience building or contributing to mobile apps (iOS & Android).

Backend experience with Python and FastAPI (or strong willingness to work on backend components). Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred). Understanding of responsive and mobile-first design principles. Strong communication skills in a remote startup environment. Nice to Have Experience with Flutter .

Experience in fintech or real-time data applications. Familiarity with financial data visualization libraries. Experience in early-stage startups. Docker and CI/CD familiarity. 💡 Please Note - Equity-Only Structure This is a part-time, equity-only role, suitable as a side engagement alongside a primary job or consulting work.

The position will transition to compensated status after the MVP launch and once funding or sustainable revenue is secured. If you're excited about joining an early-stage mission-driven startup and helping build a next-generation trading platform, we’d love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

The Partnership and Enterprise squad is building the infrastructure that powers SumUp's partner channel, a business that supports around 800 active partners and is growing fast.

As the squad's Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you'll take end-to-end ownership of the Partner Portal, the product that sits at the heart of how SumUp's partners manage their merchants, fees, and operations.

This is an opportunity with real scope: you'll shape technical direction, collaborate closely with CRM engineers and product stakeholders, and ship features that directly reduce operational friction for the teams driving SumUp's sales growth.

Build and own the Partner Portal's frontend using React, TypeScript, and Next.js, creating fast, reliable, and well-structured user-facing experiences
Design, build, and maintain the services and microservices that power the portal, ensuring reliability and high availability at scale
Write and maintain back-end APIs, services, and data pipelines in TypeScript and Go that are scalable and built to support a fast-growing global platform
Develop fee management functionality and other high-impact features that directly reduce the administrative burden on partner management teams
Implement monitoring and alerting, and follow up on incidents to keep the platform stable and performant
Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across the Partnerships team to identify areas of improvement, collect feature requests, and shape solutions
Actively contribute to code reviews, team ceremonies, and chapter rituals, sharing context and knowledge across engineering disciplines to avoid silos

Project background
We train open foundation models with hundreds of billions of parameters on thousands of GPUs on one of the largest AI-ready supercomputers in Europe. The team counts more than a dozen full-time engineers working alongside leading researchers from EPFL and ETH Zürich, has released the Apertus 1 and Apertus 1.5 models, and works with over thirty academic collaborators to deliver fully open (open source), responsibly trained, multilingual, multimodal AI models for research and industry.
Apertus is trained and developed on Alps, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre's supercomputing infrastructure. The role requires someone who is comfortable working in an HPC environment and collaborating with researchers and infrastructure engineers.

· Work with researchers and CSCS engineers to improve the reliability and performance of large-scale experiments
LLM post-training and reinforcement learning

· Generate and validate synthetic or gym training tasks
· Run ablation studies comparing algorithms, reward functions, data mixtures, hyperparameters, and infrastructure settings
· Evaluate model behaviour across reasoning, coding, mathematics, instruction-following, multilingual, tool-use, and safety benchmarks
· Debug common post-training issues, including optimisation instability, reward hacking, regressions, and evaluation failures

⭐️ Your Impact: The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software
penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour
productivity gap runs about 30%. Millions of skilled people spend their evenings
on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to
deliver the energy transition.
There is almost no incumbent software to displace. That is unusual, and it won't
last.
smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool
to manage. In the last six months that went from a partner app and a dashboard
to around thirty AI agents in production - pricing real jobs, qualifying real
leads, running the operations of businesses whose payroll depends on it working.
These days building thirty agents is easy. Knowing which thirty is what's challenging.
That only comes from being in the Betrieb and talking to the Handwerker.
That's what this role is for.

You'll sit in Handwerksbetrieben - at the Meister's desk, in the van, on site, next to our team -
and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the
thing that fixes it, often multiple times on the same day.
· Spend real time with partners. Not a quarterly customer call. You'll know
our Meister by name, understand their P&L, and notice the thing they've
stopped complaining about because they assume it can't be fixed.
· Build across the stack. Python/FastAPI services, Vue interfaces, Flutter
screens, agent loops, data pipelines - whatever the problem needs.
· Own agents in production. Not demos. Agents that price real jobs, answer
real customers, and cost real money when they're wrong. Reliability,
evaluation, structured output, graceful failure.
· Decide what to build. You'll write your own acceptance criteria. Nobody
here will hand you a spec, and waiting for one is how to fail in this
role.
· Measure whether it worked. Hours saved per partner, offers that go out
untouched, leads answered before a competitor picks up. If the number didn't
move, it didn't work.
What that looks like in practice
In July one of our Meister got an early build of the partner app, ahead of the
general rollout. He tested it between jobs and sent screenshots: from a calendar
appointment he could no longer jump into the project to pull the customer's
phone number. He had a reply in two minutes. Within the hour he'd also asked for
a navigation button - tap the address, go straight to maps.
Neither was news. Both were already being worked on before he hit send.
We aim to be fast, and close enough to the work that we've usually seen the problem before the person living it has to tell us.

carried.

At Magpie, we envision a world where every child, no matter their background, becomes a confident reader. Our nonprofit team combines research-backed instruction, joyful game design, and innovative technology to tackle America’s reading crisis head-on — with the goal of eradicating illiteracy through a digital-first, student-centered approach.

We’re seeking an experienced Full Stack - Senior Software Engineer to join our small, mission-driven Platform team. You’ll wear many hats, work across boundaries, and help us build a platform that scales impact—not just traffic.
In this role, you’ll design and build the core systems that power Magpie’s learning experiences, from scalable backend services to intuitive front-end interfaces and reliable data pipelines. You’ll help create experiences that meet every child where they are in their learning journey, while unlocking actionable insights for educators and families.
You’re drawn to missions that matter. You think deeply about the systems behind learning, not just the code. You balance pragmatism with curiosity and build for the long term. The ideal candidate pairs strong technical execution with deep empathy for users, thrives in a collaborative startup environment, and is motivated by the opportunity to make reading joyful and accessible for all.

Présents dans 24 pays avec 1 800 collaborateurs dont 200 profils techniques à Paris, nous déployons des solutions techniques sur-mesure pour de grands groupes mondiaux dans tous les secteurs clés de l’économie – industrie, retail, luxe, grande consommation, santé, finance. Pionniers engagés, nous favorisons l'IA éthique via notre Centre de Recherche à Paris et Shanghai.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Vous avez envie d’être au cœur de la révolution IA en cours et ne voulez pas rater la vague.
Vous souhaitez travailler sur des cas d’usages GenAI, ou concevoir des architectures où les modèles de langage ne sont plus une fin en soi, mais un composant parmi d'autres: orchestré, évalué, contrôlé. Au quotidien, vous utilisez vous-mêmes des coding agents pour aller plus vite et mieux. Pas comme gadget, mais comme levier de productivité réel, intégré à votre façon de travailler.
Vous n'êtes pas là pour réaliser des POC. Vous êtes là pour résoudre des problèmes que peu de Software Engineers ont encore eu à affronter.
Nos Software Engineers sont les développeurs et architectes de confiance de nos clients, intervenant sur des problématiques de pointe. Ils interviennent sur des missions stratégiques telles que la construction de Data Platform robustes sur GCP ou l’élaboration d’architectures complexes pour des Agentic Platform.
Lassé(e) de travailler sur la même data pipeline depuis deux ans ? Ici, vous changez de secteur, de stack technologiques et défis stratégiques fréquemment, tout en capitalisant sur chaque expérience acquise.
Si vous cherchez un poste où vous ferez la même chose dans un an, passez votre chemin ! Chez Artefact, chaque nouvelle mission est une opportunité de monter en compétences sur une nouvelle stacks technologique ou un nouveau secteur business.
Vous souhaitez rejoindre un accélérateur de carrières dans la Data et l’IA.
Rejoindre notre équipe, c'est intégrer une communauté de Software Engineers qui partagent leurs retours d'expérience, ce qui a marché en mission et ce qui a moins bien marché. Grâce à nos rituels internes (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX de fin de mission), chaque problème résolu par un collègue devient une compétence acquise pour vous. Vous apprenez trois fois plus vite, entouré(e) par d’autres experts qui partagent le même état d'esprit.

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.
We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.
The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.
Senior or staff level depending on experience.

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.
A multi-agent orchestration SDK , built from scratch . Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.
CAD conversion as a real pipeline . It used to be manual and brittle. Turning it into production infrastructure meant writing a Python wrapper around a C++ SDK and making it reliable enough to sit under everything else.
Migrating the application off Electron and Webpack onto SSR React with Vite . That architecture is what the whole product now sits on.

3D-to-3D search across real customer part libraries, not benchmark datasets
Constraint solvers and optimization , and getting an agent to use one sensibly
Agents that hold a useful model of a physical object , which is still an open problem
Hybrid cloud deployments for manufacturers who cannot send their data anywhere
We work in Python and TypeScript, with multi-agent orchestration and AI integrations across several providers.

You have shipped production systems across frontend and backend, and can point at them
Your CV reads as a set of problems, not a stack
You use AI heavily to go faster, but you built things the hard way first
You are fine when the problem is not yet defined
You deliver end to end, and you are still there when it needs maintaining
Bonus: CAD, computational geometry, constraint solving or optimization, 3D, LLM agents, industrial software. None required.
